title: VITAdev experiment: Plus baseline with build correction
purpose: Establish Jak and Uncharted visuals from all-enhancements with its renderer, shaders and frontend unchanged. Restore the preceding Atrac9Decode call because the pinned dependency does not implement Atrac9DecodeBounded. This one-call compatibility correction is the entire native diff.
device_checks: Install over VITAdev and confirm that settings, saves and the imported Vulkan driver remain available.
Use the same actual Vulkan driver, save, camera, resolution and memory mapping as Vita3K-Plus.
Check Jak's sky, terrain, water and HUD, and Uncharted's black rectangle, lighting and shadows.
After shader compilation finishes, restart and repeat the same scenes. Record the driverID line and paired screenshots.
Compare dialogue, music and sound effects. The shared ATRAC9 correction restores the existing decoder API; bounded decoding remains unavailable.
